chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 524: The War of Immortals Begins – A New Enemy Appears
chapter_meta_description: The Seamless Gate's full-scale war begins! Ji Ning leads the vanguard, but must contend with a chilling new enemy who knows his weaknesses. The Heartforge Tribulation of the Three Realms is here.
og_title: The War of the Immortals Commences!
og_description: Ji Ning enters the mid-stage of his epic journey. A terrifying "Venomous Clown" offers a clinical analysis of his swordplay, and the true war begins!
twitter_description: The Seamless Gate mobilizes! Ji Ning faces a new kind of enemy—one who understands his swordplay better than he does. Chapter 524 is out now!

lore_anchors.definition: The final and most dangerous part of a Heavenly Tribulation in Xianxia. It does not attack the body, but instead traps the cultivator's soul within a supremely realistic, personalized illusion crafted to exploit their deepest desires and fears. Only an unshakable Dao-heart can break free.

A Xianxia concept of accumulated destiny and luck belonging to a realm, clan, or individual. If this "Qi" is damaged or stolen, the target becomes vulnerable to disaster, misfortune, and conquest. It is a strategic asset in cosmic wars.

A Ki Refiner who has successfully overcome the Three Calamities and Nine Tribulations, achieving a body of pure Yang energy and effectively unlimited lifespan. In the context of this war, they have been reduced to the rank of "squad leaders," showing the terrifying scale of the conflict.

The primary antagonistic faction in the Three Realms arc. An organization of cultivators and Fiendgods who follow Old Man Yuan, seeking to break the natural order of the Heavenly Dao and conquer the universe.

A mysterious new antagonist attached to Ji Ning's forces. He is characterized by a cheerful, analytical demeanor, dissecting his target's strengths and weaknesses with a clinical smile, making him a master of psychological warfare.
